acolyte_a: Pell: The heat in here makes Spirlings restless.
acolyte_a_intro: Pell: We tend the Warden while he's lost in the Hush. Prove you can help him!
acolyte_a_defeat: Pell: Go on, then. Orrin is at the tear.
acolyte_b: Suri: Orrin has guarded this hollow for years. He hasn't said a word since the storm.
acolyte_b_intro: Suri: My Kindlop runs hot. Ready?
acolyte_b_defeat: Suri: Cooled off... just like that.

lines: Orrin: I'd forgotten my own Spirlings' names. Thank you for reminding me.
Orrin: The tear is stitched. Mark it on your map, cartographer.

orrin_intro: His Spirlings step forward on their own. They want him back.
orrin_defeat: Warden Orrin: I can hear them again. Quickly, help me close the tear!
heart: A knot of Hush smoulders in the Rift's heart.
heart_intro: Warden Orrin: Wait. Something is still down there.
The last of the Hush pools into one burning heart.
Warden Orrin: Bring every Spirling you have. We face it together!
heart_defeat: The heart cools to grey stone and crumbles away.
Warden Orrin: That was the last of it. The Cinder Rift breathes again.
kindle_vents_sign: Inside: Plank Bundle. Hot vents blow every few seconds: wait for the calm.
